payload.text: The capture window has two real bounds and the contract states whether both can be met. VC'S EARLIER FRAMING WAS BACKWARDS AND IS CORRECTED HERE: ambient MITIGATES rather than compounds, because ease is capped at max_ease so the 1.4 multiplier never bites at the cap while dwell's 1.5 always does. Measured -- dwell 2500 ease 3000 gives a window of MINUS 500ms at default pace (the transition outlasts the slide) and PLUS 750ms under ambient. Default pace is the broken case, at any configured ease at or above 2500. vc computed only the ambient case and described it comparatively against a default case never computed: a population of one, reported as a comparison. Once AC-3.11's compile-time cap and refusal land, no config reaching the runtime can have ease >= dwell and this bound is closed at the source. AND THE ROW'S POPULATION IS THE HARNESS, NOT ONE COMMAND: measured 2026-09-09 by snorkeltoast, both bounds are computed and lo >= hi returns None in control and compare, with selftest covering a legal ease-3000 / dwell-2500 windowless config and both sides of the narrowest window (dwell 1301 gives (1100,1100); dwell 1300 gives None), so FLOORS.md's "0 windowless" is a RESULT and not a tautology. BUT cmd_capture and cmd_redproof pass no budget_for and capture at a flat 4000ms, computing no window at all -- two of four commands honour the bounds. Harmless on this reel, whose window is 1100..4520 so 4000 sits inside it, which is why redproof's numbers stand; on a legal dwell-2500 reel the same path photographs the NEXT slide while labelling it this one. FIXED AT snorkeltoast 28b4127 AND VERIFIED BY vc AT THE SOURCE, with one leg still unverified. The derivation is now ONE windows_for() at showreel-harness:381 with three consumers -- cmd_capture, cmd_control and cmd_redproof -- where control had it inline and capture and redproof had nothing; and capture() now DIES with "capture() was called with no per-slide budget" rather than defaulting. snorkeltoast's reasoning is the right one and is worth keeping: fixing it at the two call sites would have left the default sitting there for the next caller, and A DEFAULT THAT IS WRONG ON SOME INPUTS CANNOT BE FIXED BY REMEMBERING TO OVERRIDE IT. Re-measured against 008 at the corrected budgets, 1100ms on all 22 slides against 4000ms before: slide 6 red at 0.999752 unchanged, 13 at 0.001500 and 14 at 0.002196 at their control floors exactly -- the injury figure holding at a budget nearly four times earlier in the dwell, which is what reduced motion predicts and is now measured rather than assumed. THE UNVERIFIED LEG IS cmd_compare, which is not among windows_for's three call sites; vc has not established where it takes its budgets from, and grading a row on three of four commands after the row was minted about two of four would repeat the error in a smaller size. THE FOURTH LEG WAS A REAL GAP AND NOT A BOOKKEEPING ONE -- snorkeltoast established it after vc declined to satisfy the row on their summary, and their earlier statement that both bounds were computed "in control and compare" was wrong about compare. compare CAPTURES NOTHING: it reads two manifests and diffs the shots already in them, so the budgets are whatever the commands that wrote those directories recorded, and nothing compared them. LIVE UNTIL 28b4127: `capture` wrote 4000ms manifests while `control` wrote per-slide ones, so comparing a capture-made directory against a control rep graded 4000ms frames against 1100ms ones -- a real number measuring a PHASE difference and presenting it as a build difference, which is the pace=ambient defect of AC-2.13 arriving through a different door. Fixed at fab0924: compare refuses before the partition and before any pixel, under F2's existing rule that incomparable sides fail without a number. RED-PROVED BOTH WAYS, and the red case is the one worth reading -- the same shots with two budgets doctored IN THE MANIFEST ONLY, pixels BIT-IDENTICAL, giving "CAPTURE MISMATCH -- 2 slide(s) were photographed at different budgets. No pixel number is reported", exit 1, and grep -c RMSE returning 0. The old code would have printed RMSE 0.000000 down the whole reel and passed green. THE CHECK HAS TO FIRE ON THE PROVENANCE OF THE COMPARISON RATHER THAN ON ITS RESULT, BECAUSE THE RESULT IS PERFECT. Both paths now derive from windows_for, which means they agree because two code paths compute the same thing -- not a guarantee, and what an assertion is for. Discharged when the refusal is verified by vc at the source, the last leg vc has not read.
